summary: Iteration-7 HRMS + Payroll + 3-stage reimbursement testing. Added /app/backend/tests/test_finance_hrms.py with 22 tests covering Staff CRUD RBAC, Attendance upsert+filter, Leaves, Reimbursement 3-stage flow (L1 snapshot, accountant, pay->expense txn side-effect, reject, list-scoping), and Payroll (days math, idempotency, pay->expense txn, double-pay rejection). Found+fixed 1 backend bug. 22/22 new + 56/56 prior regression = 78/78 pass.
critical_code_review_comments: BUG FIXED: POST /api/attendance was building $set/$setOnInsert that both touched the `id` field, causing Mongo WriteError 'Updating path id would create a conflict at id' on the 2nd upsert for the same (staff_id,date). Fixed by removing `id` from the $set dict (now only set on insert). server.py L987-993.

Payroll run prorates monthly_salary by days_present/last_day even when only a few attendance entries exist — for staff with monthly_salary>0 and no per_day_rate, a single 'present' day yields ~3.3% of salary. This is the intended option-2b behaviour (monthly + per-day attendance×rate) but worth a UI note so admins understand draft amounts.
Payroll txn date uses `working_days` (last day of month) as the day-of-month, producing dates like 2025-06-30. Fine for monthly bookkeeping but consider using `paid_at` date for clarity.

Reimbursement /list scoping for non-elevated roles uses a $or of {created_by, staff_id, l1_approver_id}. Admin/manager/accountant/center_manager all bypass scoping and see everything — correct per spec; verified.
_resolve_staff_for_user (line 940) is dead code (returns None and is never called); only the async _staff_for_user is used. Safe to remove.
payroll_run inserts then pops `_id` from the local doc dict before appending to `created` — good. Same pattern used correctly in reimb_pay.
test_credentials: admin@finance.app / Admin@123 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Tests create TEST_-prefixed users (mgr/emp/rnd/acct) and staff with UUID-suffixed names for isolation.
seed_data_creation: Per-test-module: 4 TEST users (mgr, emp, rnd, acct@finance with role patched to 'accountant'), 2 staff records (mgr-staff linked to mgr user; emp-staff with reports_to=mgr-staff and user_id=emp user), 5 attendance rows for June 2025 (3 present, 1 half, 1 leave after upsert), 2 reimbursements (one paid through full flow, one rejected), 1 payroll row for emp 6/2025 paid through.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v` for full regression (78 tests, ~21s). All test files use uuid-suffixed names/emails so re-runs are idempotent. Note: attendance upsert bug was fixed in this iteration; if main agent re-runs without the fix the TestAttendance::test_upsert_and_filter test (and downstream Payroll tests) will fail with 500.
rca of the issue: Attendance upsert bug — root cause: pymongo refuses an update operation that touches the same path in $set and $setOnInsert. The handler did `doc['id'] = uuid(); $set: doc, $setOnInsert: {id: doc['id']}`. On first insert it worked because $setOnInsert is preferred; on the 2nd call (re-upsert same (staff_id,date)) Mongo sees that $set contains `id` and $setOnInsert also has `id`, raising code 40 ('would create a conflict at id'). Fix: keep new uuid only in $setOnInsert, and never include `id` in the $set dict. Verified by re-running tests.
